value.title: Usable independent SDK and CLI foundation
value.summary: Five guide-owned units; PM baseline, three baseline-only coder lanes, PM composition. All assertions are unchecked until observed proof.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Current guide owns all interfaces/fences/check argv; latest independent approval and seal are required before dispatch. PM tk-0001 precedes independent tk-0002 SDK, tk-0003 CLI frontend and tk-0005 proof/tooling; PM tk-0004 composes them. See context-brief.md.

value.title: PM contract baseline
value.success: PM pij-right-kotallo implements the smallest real shared core types/ports/errors and testkit fakes/fixtures, root workspace/dependency policy and isolated test helpers, then commits and seals the baseline. No SDK/CLI stub behavior.
value.notes: Guide unit tk-0001; wave 0; dependencies none. Exact fences/interfaces: ../../impl-guide.dd.json#units/tk-0001. Requested roles and proof are guide-owned; no coder validation/formatting mid-flight.
value.note: Current18-file baseline independently reviewed and actually sealed; no product AC/composition claim.

value.title: Coder A SDK and configuration service
value.success: Implement unisphere-sdk: pure JSON configuration parsing/resolution, Inspector<R> orchestration over core ports, bounded StdConfigReader and public facade/rustdoc. Own focused SDK tests and documentation.
value.notes: Guide unit tk-0002; wave 1; dependencies tk-0001. Exact fences/interfaces: ../../impl-guide.dd.json#units/tk-0002. Requested roles and proof are guide-owned; no coder validation/formatting mid-flight.

value.title: Coder B CLI frontend
value.success: Implement unisphere-cli as a frontend library with clap parsing, explicit context, machine/human rendering and exit behavior; test solely through core InspectionApi/FakeInspector. Production executable wiring is PM-owned.
value.notes: Guide unit tk-0003; wave 1; dependencies tk-0001. Exact fences/interfaces: ../../impl-guide.dd.json#units/tk-0003. Requested roles and proof are guide-owned; no coder validation/formatting mid-flight.

value.title: PM production composition and acceptance
value.success: PM pij-right-kotallo imports verified coder deliveries, adds unisphere-app executable wiring, resolves integration without changing unit internals silently, regenerates PM-owned assets and verifies the exact composed commit.
value.notes: Guide unit tk-0004; wave 2; dependencies tk-0001, tk-0002, tk-0003, tk-0005. Exact fences/interfaces: ../../impl-guide.dd.json#units/tk-0004. Requested roles and proof are guide-owned; no coder validation/formatting mid-flight.

value.title: Coder C proof and development tooling
value.success: Implement kind-aware dependency checks with negative fixtures, standalone proof executables, isolated external SDK/install/CLI smoke runners, engineering-harness wrappers and development/CI documentation. Tools can be developed against baseline contracts before SDK/CLI/app exist.
value.notes: Guide unit tk-0005; wave 1; dependencies tk-0001. Exact fences/interfaces: ../../impl-guide.dd.json#units/tk-0005. Requested roles and proof are guide-owned; no coder validation/formatting mid-flight.

tk-0001.assertion: Core DTOs/ports and fixed-copy Failure constructors expose the approved typed contract; actual core/testkit library tests pass without SDK/CLI/app.
tk-0001.note: Required instrument: guide vd-0001. Not executed at task authoring.

tk-0001.assertion: FakeReader/FakeInspector record explicit inputs without ambient access; bounded fake reads and all shared config fixtures are usable independently.
tk-0001.note: Required instrument: guide vd-0001. Not executed at task authoring.

tk-0001.assertion: sealed_command constructs a child using only caller-authorized temporary paths, cleared environment and empty PATH; native launch requires an absolute executable.
tk-0001.note: Required instrument: guide vd-0001. Not executed at task authoring.

tk-0001.assertion: Independent source-bound baseline review is approved and Builder seals the committed contract files; composition-owned Cargo.lock exception is probed and any disagreement resolved.
tk-0001.note: Required instrument: guide review/seal. Not executed at task authoring.

tk-0002.assertion: SDK validates every supplied layer, malformed/non-UTF8/duplicate/unknown-key/type/blank/oversized inputs and preserves valid roots exactly.
tk-0002.note: Required instrument: guide vd-0002. Not executed at task authoring.

tk-0002.assertion: Defaults < explicit document < explicit override precedence includes omitted retention and Some([]) clearing, without implicit ambient reads.
tk-0002.note: Required instrument: guide vd-0002. Not executed at task authoring.

tk-0002.assertion: Bounded explicit absolute-file reader maps missing/permission/oversize safely; actual service module executes without adapter/facade/sibling imports.
tk-0002.note: Required instrument: guide vd-0002. Not executed at task authoring.

tk-0003.assertion: CLI frontend exercises argument parsing, config-path resolution and all override requests against FakeInspector without SDK dependency.
tk-0003.note: Required instrument: guide vd-0003. Not executed at task authoring.

tk-0003.assertion: JSON/human/terminal precedence, help/version, stable envelopes, LF framing, stream routing, exit0/1/2 and writer failure behavior meet the contract.
tk-0003.note: Required instrument: guide vd-0003. Not executed at task authoring.

tk-0003.assertion: CLI failures use core-owned safe diagnostics without leaking hostile argument/config values.
tk-0003.note: Required instrument: guide vd-0003. Not executed at task authoring.

tk-0004.assertion: Real assembled app and SDK agree on valid/malformed/missing/unreadable/oversized inputs and diagnostic secrecy.
tk-0004.note: Required instrument: guide vd-0004. Not executed at task authoring.

tk-0004.assertion: External temporary Cargo consumer exercises SDK facade/injection under sealed hostile environments without CLI/Node/daemon runtime dependencies.
tk-0004.note: Required instrument: guide vd-000a. Not executed at task authoring.

tk-0004.assertion: CLI installs into a temporary root and executes outside the checkout with empty runtime PATH, including machine defaults and human success/failure stream checks.
tk-0004.note: Required instrument: guide vd-000b. Not executed at task authoring.

tk-0004.assertion: Composed workspace tests, clippy, formatting, architecture and rustdoc checks pass on an observed coherent toolchain.
tk-0004.note: Required instrument: guide vd-0006/0007/0008/0009/000c. Not executed at task authoring.

tk-0004.assertion: Harness checks and foundation-only boot pass; injected child failures propagate a failing readiness verdict.
tk-0004.note: Required instrument: guide vd-000d/000e/000f. Not executed at task authoring.

tk-0004.assertion: SDK/CLI/README/development examples reproduce success and actionable failure; scope/platform limits and reuse provenance are accurate.
tk-0004.note: Required instrument: guide vd-000a/000b/000c. Not executed at task authoring.

tk-0004.assertion: Independent Opus high composition review approves the exact Builder-verified commit and explicitly inspects bp-0008 core/SDK no-network/ambient/process/FFI/unsafe surfaces.
tk-0004.note: Required instrument: guide composition review. Not executed at task authoring.

tk-0005.assertion: Proof-tool binary unit tests run on baseline alone; kind-aware graph allowlist rejects forbidden normal/dev/build edges using negative fixtures.
tk-0005.note: Required instrument: guide vd-0005. Not executed at task authoring.

tk-0005.assertion: Proof runners materialize only temporary packages from template manifests, preserve child failure evidence, and fail honestly when product targets are absent.
tk-0005.note: Required instrument: guide vd-0005. Not executed at task authoring.

tk-0005.assertion: Checks/boot wrappers and documented local/CI lane enforce observed coherent rustc/cargo/clippy/rustfmt provenance and propagate child failure, without global changes.
tk-0005.note: Required instrument: guide vd-000f. Not executed at task authoring.
